changelog: CSM now replaces the Compose settings landing page only while it is open, instead of placing a sibling overlay over CloudStream.

The replacement is one real scrollable settings page: Extensions is followed immediately by CSM, then the version/build line. CSM uses the same native row geometry, ripple, title/subtitle treatment, and a larger 32dp icon.
Every host category keeps its original navigation target. Leaving the settings landing page restores CloudStream's untouched Compose screen; legacy XML settings remain on their established path.
The replacement is enabled only on Compose settings hosts without a public plugin-row API; no CloudStream APK or host source is modified.
